reports.title: Liberia Consumer Price Index (LCPI) Newsletter
reports.publisher: Liberia Institute of Statistics & Geo-Information Services (LISGIS)
reports.description: Liberia's national CPI. Directly verified via pdftotext extraction of the June 2023 newsletter PDF: "Liberia's CPI Basket has a Weight Reference Period of 2016 while the Price is referenced to December 2018. The Index is chain-linked to December 2005." A chart caption on p.2 (self-verified) reads "Figure 2: Inflation Rates (%) by the 12 major COICOP Functions, June 2023" — confirming COICOP classification directly from the primary document. NOTE: three overlapping "base" concepts (2016 weight reference, December 2018 price reference, December 2005 chain-link) are not reconciled into one figure by the document itself — flagged rather than resolved. LISGIS's own pricestats.php listing page (AI-summarized only, not independently re-fetched) suggests continued monthly releases through at least June 2026, though it states a 15th-of-month publication target that conflicts with the newsletter's own stated 10th-of-month target (per a WebFetch summary of a different page, also not independently re-verified) — both recorded, conflict not resolved.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly; exact publication-date target has two conflicting sourced figures (10th vs. 15th of the following month), neither independently re-verified this round.

reports.title: Local Government Act of 2018 (House's Enrolled Bill No. 13, First Session of the Fifty-Fourth Legislature)
reports.publisher: Legislature of the Republic of Liberia
reports.description: Liberia's Local Government Act, 2018 — resolves this file's own earlier `_dropped` note. Grok located a copy of the actual enrolled bill (hosted by Forest Trends, a third-party conservation NGO, but the document itself is the House of Representatives' own official text: title page reads "AN ACT TO REPEAL THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT LAW TITLE 20, LIBERIAN CODES OF LAW REVISED AND TO ESTABLISH IN ITS STEAD, A NEW TITLE 20 TO BE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT OF 2018"). Directly re-fetched and pdfplumber-extracted this round (not AI-summarized) to confirm and expand on Grok's title-page-only quote. Section 4.15 ("Transfers and Grants from Central Government"): "Counties, cities and townships shall receive the following transfers and grants from the central government: a. General Fund;" and "The central government shall establish transfers for counties, cities and townships to finance functions and responsibilities devolved from central government." Section 4.33d ("Revenue Fund"): "Revenue Funds shall be established for county, city, township and boroughs... All revenues received by counties, cities and townships, pursuant to this Act shall be deposited into the Revenue Fund." Section 4.26 establishes an autonomous "National Local Government Fiscal Board" responsible for annual grant-allocation recommendations to the Legislature. CAVEAT: this PDF is a lower-quality scan than most primary sources used in this branch — Sections 4.19–4.25 (including 4.20, "County Social Development Fund," the section NAYMOTE's earlier-cited paraphrase corresponds to) are OCR-garbled beyond reliable verbatim quotation; only the cleanly-extractable sections above are quoted here. This confirms and upgrades the NAYMOTE paraphrase this file previously declined to mint from, without fully superseding it (Section 4.20's own text remains unverifiable at OCR quality).

_dropped.why: No document authored by LISGIS itself, or a Liberian NSDS, names ECOWAS, WAMA/AMAO, AFRISTAT, MRU, the African Charter on Statistics, or SHaSA in connection with Liberia's CPI or statistical methodology — genuine NOT FOUND despite search. Closest adjacent (NOT minted, does not satisfy the sourcing rule): a World Bank Project Appraisal Document (P169265, 'Harmonizing and Improving Statistics in West Africa') states "In the cases of Ghana, Liberia and Sierra Leone, the CPI will be updated following the model used by the WAEMU Commission" — but this is World-Bank-authored (not LISGIS-authored) and describes a FUTURE/planned reform, not current practice, so it does not meet the branch's edge-sourcing standard.

Liberia's Local Government Act, 2018 was originally searched for extensively (Ministry of Internal Affairs/Local Government, Governance Commission, FAOLEX, NATLEX, SNG-WOFI) without finding the primary text — only a NAYMOTE civil-society FAQ paraphrase. FOLLOW-UP 2026-08-13 (Grok located a copy hosted by Forest Trends): the primary enrolled-bill text is now minted as `lr-local-government-act-2018`, with real Section 4.15/4.26/4.33d quotes independently re-extracted this round. No edge is drawn between it and `lr-lisgis-lcpi` — LISGIS's CPI newsletter has no reason to cite a local-government fiscal law, so this was never a plausible edge; the two nodes simply coexist in the same country file. Kept as `reason: 'note'` rather than 'resolved', since no edge naming this pair actually exists in the graph. The County Social Development Fund (CSDF) mechanism NAYMOTE described corresponds to the Act's own Section 4.20, which remains OCR-garbled beyond reliable verbatim quotation in the copy located this round — still not independently confirmed at primary-text quality.
